# GitHub Copilot Instructions

## Repository Overview

This repository is a project workspace. When working with this codebase, please follow the guidelines below.

## Code Style and Standards

- Follow best practices for the programming languages used in this repository
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code
- Use meaningful variable and function names
- Add comments for complex logic

## Development Workflow

- Make small, incremental changes
- Test changes thoroughly before committing
- Write clear commit messages that describe what changed and why

## Pull Request Guidelines

- Keep pull requests focused and scoped to a single feature or fix
- Provide clear descriptions of changes
- Include test coverage for new features

## Testing

- Ensure all tests pass before submitting changes
- Add tests for new functionality
- Update existing tests when modifying behavior

## Documentation

- Update relevant documentation when making changes
- Keep README.md up to date
- Document any new features or APIs

## General Guidelines

- Prioritize code readability and maintainability
- Follow the principle of least surprise
- Consider edge cases and error handling
- Optimize for clarity first, performance second
